titles.title: Claude scoped session progress budget cancellation and legacy behavior
claude reviewer-session arguments allow reading and insrc analyze only
codex reviewer-session arguments use a read-only sandbox
a claude reviewer session runs in the repo with the session arguments and returns the checked answer
a codex reviewer session takes the LAST message as the answer
a session with no checked answer fails
a transient CLI error is retried once
a transient CLI error is never retried more than once
an error that is not transient is not retried
a session is stopped at its deadline and that is not retried
the retry gets only the time that remains
no attempt starts once the deadline has passed
one-shot calls and the edit session build the same arguments as before
a codex reviewer session that produces no model output is killed early and retried once as a fresh run
a codex run silent twice fails with its session named, and a run that is answering is never cut by the stall limit
only the reviewer session is watched: a one-shot codex call that is silent at first is not cut by the stall limit
a structured codex call with stallMs kills a run that prints no output and throws CliStallError
a structured codex call with stallMs kills a run that prints an item event and then goes silent, stallMs after its last output
a structured codex call that keeps printing within stallMs completes, and without stallMs no watchdog is armed
claude ignores stallMs and reviewer sessions keep the first-output watchdog
a codex reviewer session given stallMs is killed after that much stdout silence, also after an early item event, and throws CliStallError
a codex reviewer session without stallMs keeps the first-output watchdog: model output printed early then a long silence is not a stall
a size refusal in a claude session envelope is now an InputTooLargeError, and a codex session refusal still is
with effort, claude invocations carry --effort <e> and codex invocations carry -c model_reasoning_effort=<e>, in complete, structured, edit session and both review sessions
without effort every argv is byte-identical to today's
provider profile and normalized enveloped wire schema agree before planning and dispatch without config writes
review-scoped provider and driver logs redact sentinel content on all failure paths
